# Turn a messy customer review into a polished testimonial with Cohere


You’ve just received a heartfelt but messy customer review. Instead of leaving it as-is, you’d like to polish it into a concise, professional testimonial you can proudly share on your website or social media. With Cohere’s free AI assistant, you can do this in minutes — no writing experience needed.

## Before you start
- A **free Cohere account** (sign-up takes 2 minutes at [cohere.com](https://cohere.com))
- A **customer review** (text you want to clean up)
- A **device with internet** (computer, tablet, or phone)
- **Total time**: about 8 minutes

---

## Step 1 — Sign in to Cohere and open the chat
Go to [cohere.com](https://cohere.com) and click **Sign In** in the top-right corner. Enter your email and password, then press **Enter**. You’ll land on the Cohere dashboard. Look for a chat bubble or a box that says **“Start a new chat”** in the middle of the screen. Click it to open a fresh conversation.

You’ll see a blinking cursor and a prompt that says **“Ask me anything…”**

💬 Example:
`I’d like help turning a customer review into a polished testimonial.`

You'll know it worked when the chat window is open and you see the prompt ready for your input.

---

## Step 2 — Paste the raw customer review
Copy the messy customer review from your email or notes. Then, in the chat box at the bottom, paste the text. Press **Enter** or click the send arrow.

For example, paste something like:
> “I was really frustrated when my order arrived late, but the customer service team called me right away and fixed everything within a day. They even sent a discount code for my next purchase. I’m actually really happy with how they handled it and will definitely order again.”

You'll know it worked when the review appears in the chat, and Cohere starts typing a response.

---

## Step 3 — Ask Cohere to polish the review into a testimonial
Below the pasted review, type your request in plain words. Keep it simple:

💬 Example:
`Please turn this into a short, professional testimonial suitable for sharing on our website or social media. Keep it under 50 words.`

Press **Enter**. Cohere will process your request and generate a polished version.

You'll know it worked when you see a new message from Cohere with a clean, concise testimonial like:
> “Our order arrived late, but the team responded quickly, resolved the issue within a day, and even sent a discount for our next purchase. We’re thrilled with the service and will definitely order again.”

---

## Step 4 — Review and tweak the output
Read the polished testimonial carefully. If it’s perfect, great! If not, you can ask Cohere to adjust it. For example, you might want it shorter, warmer, or more specific.

💬 Example:
`Make it shorter and more enthusiastic. Use “amazing” instead of “thrilled”.`

Press **Enter**. Cohere will revise the testimonial based on your feedback.

You'll know it worked when you see a revised version that matches your tone and length preferences.

---

## Step 5 — Copy the final testimonial
Once you’re happy with the polished review, highlight the entire text in the chat. Right-click and choose **Copy**, or use **Ctrl+C** (Windows) or **Cmd+C** (Mac).

💬 Example:
`“Our order arrived late, but the team responded amazingly fast, fixed everything within a day, and even sent a discount for our next purchase. We’ll definitely order again!”`

You'll know it worked when the text is highlighted and copied to your clipboard.

---

## Step 6 — Paste and share your testimonial
Open the platform where you want to share the testimonial — your website, LinkedIn, or a customer review page. Click in the text box, then paste the testimonial (**Ctrl+V** or **Cmd+V**). Add your company name and the customer’s name if appropriate. Click **Post** or **Save**.

💬 Example:
`“Thanks to [Your Company] for turning a frustrating delay into an amazing experience. Our order arrived late, but the team responded amazingly fast, fixed everything within a day, and even sent a discount for our next purchase. We’ll definitely order again!” — Maria K.`

You'll know it worked when the polished testimonial appears on the platform exactly as you intended.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Pasting the wrong text**: Always double-check that you’ve copied the correct customer review before pasting it into Cohere. If you paste the wrong text, simply paste the correct one and ask Cohere to try again.
- **Not giving clear instructions**: Be specific about length, tone, and audience. Instead of “Make it better,” say “Make it shorter and more enthusiastic.”
- **Skipping the review step**: Always read the polished testimonial before sharing it. If it doesn’t sound like your customer, ask Cohere to revise it.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life**: You can now confidently turn any raw customer feedback into a polished testimonial for your website, social media, or marketing materials — without hiring a copywriter.
- **For your business or work**: Save time and improve your brand’s image by sharing authentic, professional customer stories that build trust with new visitors.
- **If you're just getting started**: This is a simple, low-pressure way to start using AI to improve your customer communication and content.

---

## Try it now
Open [cohere.com](https://cohere.com), sign in, and paste a real customer review you’ve received. Ask Cohere to turn it into a polished testimonial under 50 words. Copy the result and share it on your website or social media today.
